values.quote: each bounce occurring over {{fd|0.495}} seconds regardless of distance
values.binNote: The bin has no timing field for bounce duration; only geometry values (MaxRange, MaxRangeFirstBounce, MaxRangeSecondBounce, BombTriggerRange) are present, none of which encode a time in seconds.

mechanics.claim: The bomb bounces forward up to two times; the distance traveled by each bounce is based on how far it was originally thrown, and it explodes on hitting an enemy, terrain, or the final bounce.
mechanics.quote: throws a bomb to the target location that bounces forward up to two times, with the distance traveled each time being based on how far it was originally thrown

mechanics.claim: The explosion deals AoE damage to nearby enemies where it lands.
mechanics.quote: The bomb explodes upon landing near an enemy, within terrain, or the final bounce, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.

mechanics.claim: A spell shield will block the explosion's damage to the shielded target, but the explosion can still damage other targets in its radius.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the damage of the explosion, but the explosion can still damage other targets in the radius.

mechanics.claim: Ziggs throws the bomb at the end of the cast time, not at cast start.
mechanics.quote: '''Ziggs''' will throw the bomb from his location at the end of the cast time
